name: Alpha-to-Weight Computation (Backward)
definition: Computes gradients of the loss with respect to alpha values given gradients of the loss with respect to weights and the final transmittance, using reverse accumulation.
summary: Alpha-to-Weight Computation (Backward) computes gradients of the rendering loss with respect to per-sample alpha values by propagating gradients backwards through ray samples, unlike the forward pass which accumulates transmittance.
